//: SeaweedFS S3 identities for the OPTIONAL in-cluster object store (deploy/k3s/objectstore.yaml).
//access: Copy this, set real keys, and load it as a Secret the manifest mounts:
//cmd: kubectl -n base-services create secret generic objectstore-secrets --from-file=s3.json=./s3.json
//keys: The SAME accessKey/secretKey go to the blob services as OBJECTSTORE_ACCESS_KEY / OBJECTSTORE_SECRET_KEY, with OBJECTSTORE_DRIVER=s3, OBJECTSTORE_ENDPOINT_URL=http://objectstore:9000, OBJECTSTORE_FORCE_PATH_STYLE=true, OBJECTSTORE_BUCKET=base-services.
